messages:
claire-sales: Quick sync  PrimeTrust wants BYO-KMS POC. Must-haves: automated KEK rotation demo, 72h pen-test window, independent HSM attestation, and clear pricing (hourly connector vs onboarding). Can we confirm constraints?
omar-se: We can demo API-driven rotation if KEK stays in their HSM and they provide wrapped test keys + thumbprints. Need traffic profile (seq len distribution) to size perf.
raj-crypto: Security: no plaintext KEK export allowed. Require signed thumbprint exchange (sha256), nonce-based handshake, and audit logs for rotation events (actor, timestamp, key-id). For attestation, customer prefers a 3rd-party report (CAVP/FIPS 140-2/3)  acceptable.
helena-legal: I'll add SOW lines: "No plaintext key material exported", rotation rollback playbook, audit-log retention 1 year, pen-test liability cap (1x monthly SLA credit or $30k). Also require attestation acceptance criteria in SOW.
ty-eng-ops: Perf: earliest slot Mon 02:00-04:00 UTC. We can prove 6k QPS for 10m with p95 <120ms if seq len <256 and caches warm. Need their allowlist for proxy IPs (sample below) and whether they insist on staging KEK vs test keys.
claire-sales: They prefer using their staging KEK end-to-end. Any blockers?
raj-crypto: OK if KEK generated in their HSM and we receive only wrapped keys + signed thumbprints. Need to verify thumbprint via our endpoint: sample curl: `curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" https://kms-proxy.redwood.example.com/thumbprint`
omar-se: Pricing: propose POC connector $125/hr + optional $12k onboarding if they want Redwood-managed certs. I'll confirm final numbers with finance.
scheduler-bot: task-created: byo-kms-3155555555 (owner=ty-eng-ops) start=3155641955 due=3155649155
ty-eng-ops: Tentatively booked Mon slot pending their allowlist and wrapped-key bundle by EOD Fri. We'll run a preflight smoke test if delivered.
helena-legal: I'll draft SOW snippets and share. raj-crypto: I'll publish minimal handshake spec (wrap-alg RSA-OAEP-256, thumbprint sha256 hex, signed nonce exchange).
claire-sales: Action list: 1) I'll confirm dates and allowlist with PrimeTrust, 2) Omar/ty to prep perf + preflight, 3) Raj to post handshake doc, 4) Helena to draft SOW + attestation criteria, 4) Omar to finalize pricing with finance. I'll send combined pack to customer today. :thumbsup:
